title: SpaceX launches new V3 Starlink satellites but suffers another booster failure | TechCrunch
summary: In May, on the first Starship V3 flight, SpaceX encountered a failure of the Starship’s Super Heavy booster as it separated from the upper stage of the rocket. The upper stage lost a rocket engine during the first V3 launch in May.
